case_name: Chandana Das and another v State of West Bengal and others
holding: The Division Bench of the Calcutta High Court has rightly held that Rule 8(3) of the Rules amounts to an imposition abridging the fundamental right and therefore a special constitution permitted under Rule 8(3) cannot be in relation to minority community institutions.
